verdict.rationale: Salesmate is a CRM SaaS platform, so official SDKs are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows 'publicly available RESTful APIs' and general 'API and integration support'; no official client SDK in any language is documented. A raw REST API is a developer building block, not an SDK, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec that SDKs could be generated from.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
